overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies dehydrated basil seeds for bulk food and beverage use. The seeds are cleaned, dried, sieved, inspected, and packed for stable handling in wholesale and export programs. Buyers can source standard material or request custom mesh, pack size, and private label options based on their order needs.

The product is offered from India with support for OEM and private label requirements, sample requests, and export documentation. Standard packs include 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5 to 10 kg bags, and small retail pouches or jars. The seeds are suitable for beverage, dessert, foodservice, and retail applications where a visible seed texture is required.
highlights: Dehydrated basil seeds for bulk supply

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity?
faqs.a: The MOQ is 5 kg for dehydrated basil seeds. Larger bulk orders can be arranged based on your packaging and shipment needs.

faqs.q: Can you provide private label packaging?
faqs.a: Yes. OEM and private label packing are available on request, including small pouches, jars, and other agreed pack formats.

faqs.q: Do you offer custom mesh sizes?
faqs.a: Yes. Custom mesh and sieving requirements can be reviewed against your target specification before order confirmation.
